scope: Corrected compact retained-state controls; original LMP/replay trajectories are inherited unchanged

protocol.optimization: Release raw columns/core after initialization; retain Nyström basis, eigenvalues and original selected indices
protocol.matched_rank: largest compact factor rank whose actual numerical array bytes fit the optimized LMP state
protocol.unchanged: kernel, split, seed, prefix, recurrence, selected/reconstructed modes, LMP actions and all replay-inclusive work counts
protocol.method_claim: No later actual-column exchange; stored selected indices preserve initialization identity. Setup peak and oracle arrays remain extra.
